details.description: FARE-20B is a multi-task evaluator model that Fireworks AI fine-tuned from OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss-20B, using rejection-sampled supervised fine-tuning across a range of domains. Rather than a general-purpose chat assistant, it is built to score and judge other models' outputs, covering pairwise comparison, step-level scoring, reference-based and reference-free verification, and single-score assessment. It has 20.9B parameters and is served through Fireworks' on-demand GPU deployment.
advantages: Fireworks describes it as covering pairwise comparison, step-level scoring, and both reference-based and reference-free verification within a single model.
disadvantages: Fireworks' product listing states this model does not support fine-tuning, serverless deployment, function calling, embeddings, reranking, or image input.
use_cases: Automated evaluation and scoring of other models' outputs (LLM-as-judge)
Pairwise comparison between two candidate responses
Step-level scoring of multi-step reasoning or agent trajectories
Reference-based and reference-free verification of generated content

notes: Only one source describes FARE-20B itself: Fireworks' own product page. Could not find a blog post, paper, or model card explaining what 'FARE' stands for, its training data in detail, or any benchmark scores, despite repeated search attempts (a dedicated fireworks.ai/blog/fare-20b post and a fireworks-ai/fare-20b Hugging Face card do not exist/are inaccessible; web search budget was also exhausted mid-task). Confident on model identity (an evaluator fine-tuned from gpt-oss-20B, published under Fireworks' own account) but details beyond that page are unconfirmed, so advantages/evaluations are kept minimal rather than guessed. The FARE-20B page itself does not attribute gpt-oss-20B to OpenAI or describe the serving API's shape; OpenAI's authorship is confirmed via Fireworks' own gpt-oss-20b page ('gpt-oss-20b is an open-weight 21.5B parameter model developed by OpenAI'), and the unverifiable 'chat-completions style API' detail was dropped.
